title: A retired free-plan limits switch is still kept on the live database and listed as a feature
what: The live database still holds the free-plan limits switch (4 routines, 7 own exercises, 3 months of charts), set to off. Since 12 November the phone app no longer reads it: the member plan rules moved into the app. The feature list still carries it as a hidden feature with a switch, so someone could turn it on expecting limits, and nothing would change.
expected: A retired switch is marked retired in the feature list, or removed, so nobody turns it on expecting an effect.
evidence: data:app_config free_limits on=false (catalog-level config row, no gym column), 2026-11-26
fix_line: Mark the free-plan limits switch as retired in the feature list, and drop it in a later database clean-up

evidence: data:catalog read 2026-11-26, 112 of 112 functions from files 0001-0033 present in pg_proc
data:catalog read 2026-11-26, 35 of 35 tables from files 0001-0033 present
data:pg_proc prosrc _terms_versions = 2026-10-24, 2026-11-10; _trial_cap = 6 months; app_limits reads app_config
